title: scabiosa columbaria subsp. suaveolens
intro: Scabiosa columbaria subsp. suaveolens, commonly known as Sweet Pincushion or Pineapple Delight, is a flowering plant species belonging to the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Scabiosa columbaria subsp. suaveolens are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
